characterList.description: A black woman with long dark hair, wearing a white lab coat, blue nitrile gloves, and glasses. She stands behind a lab bench.
characterList.name: Dr. Cheryl Burrell

content_metadata.description: An instructional video demonstrating the procedure of weighing and dissolving potassium hydrogen phthalate (KHP) for titration.

qAndA.question: What is the weight of the potassium hydrogen phthalate (KHP) measured by Dr. Burrell?
What specific type of balance does Dr. Burrell use to weigh the KHP?

qAndA.answer: To ensure all of the weighed KHP is transferred to the flask, maximizing accuracy.
qAndA.question: Why does Dr. Burrell rinse the weigh boat with the KHP solution and add it to the flask?

qAndA.answer: To create a solution of known concentration, which is then used to determine the concentration of an unknown base solution.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of dissolving KHP in water before performing a titration?

qAndA.answer: It signifies that the reading is stable and can be recorded.
qAndA.question: What does the asterisk on the balance screen indicate?

activities.description: Explains the purpose of the procedure (determine base concentration).
Identifies the standard used (potassium hydrogen phthalate - KHP).
Turns on the balance and prepares for weighing.
Explains the taring procedure with the weigh boat.
Adds KHP to the weigh boat and closes the balance doors.
Records the weight of KHP (1.004 grams).
Adds the distilled water to a 125 mL Erlenmeyer flask.
Adds the weighed KHP to the flask.
Swirls the flask to dissolve the KHP.
Rinses the weigh boat with the solution and adds the rinsing to the flask.
Mixes again to ensure complete dissolution.
States the KHP is dissolved and ready for titration.

characterInteraction.description: Dr. Burrell is the sole character, interacting with the audience through direct address and demonstration.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Educational video demonstrating a scientific procedure.

narrativeProgression.description: Step-by-step demonstration of weighing and dissolving KHP.
Conclusion, indicating readiness for the next step (titration).

scenes.thematicElements: Accuracy in measurement, proper laboratory techniques, preparation for titration.
scenes.title: Weighing and Dissolving KHP
